verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a first-party support page titled "Keyboard shortcuts in Windows". That shows Windows documents system hotkeys, but nothing describes their breadth or a launcher. The Snap layouts mentions do not say the feature is keyboard-driven, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: evidence of a keyboard-driven launcher, evidence that the whole system can be run keyboard-only, details on hotkey coverage (window management, navigation), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can operate the entire system using only the keyboard via hotkeys and a launcher
